description.zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account (agent logon name).

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique ID of the client request, which is used for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate this ID.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The instance ID of Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS). You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.

description.zh:
小休原因，有以下枚举：
1：小休（默认）
2：就餐
3：会议
4：辅导
5：培训
description.en:
The reason for the break. Valid values:

1: break (default)
2: meal
3: meeting
4: coaching
5: training.
